n846804840f7.s: Andhra Pradesh's installed power capacity has no component from:
n846804840f7.x: AP's capacity mix is thermal, hydel, gas and renewables; it has no nuclear capacity.

nb45db9acbd2.s: Andhra Pradesh's 22.36 lakh farm pump sets receive free daytime power for:
nb45db9acbd2.x: The 22.36 lakh farm pump sets get nine hours of free daytime power; aqua power is priced at Rs 1.50 per unit.

nccf0f96fdb8.s: Andhra Pradesh's Green Hydrogen Valley Declaration, aiming to make the State the 'Green Hydrogen Capital', was adopted at Amaravati on:
nccf0f96fdb8.x: The Green Hydrogen Valley Declaration was adopted at Amaravati on 19 July 2025.

n349b07e237b.s: How many regional medical hubs for medical tourism did the Union Budget 2026-27 propose?
n349b07e237b.x: The Union Budget 2026-27 proposed five regional medical hubs, along with five university townships in industrial corridors.

nac53509031c.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nac53509031c.x: Swadesh Darshan 1.0 (thematic circuits) had 76 projects sanctioned, of which 75 were completed.

n8cf5f21c001.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Data Center Policy 4.0 – land incentives for GCCs
LIFT Policy 4.0 – up to 1 GW data-centre capacity
Data Center Policy 4.0 – up to 10 GW capacity
LIFT Policy 4.0 – land incentives for GCCs and IT infrastructure developers
n8cf5f21c001.x: LIFT Policy 4.0 gives land incentives for GCCs and IT infrastructure developers; the Data Center Policy 4.0 targets up to 1 GW.

n810781e20e5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati Drone Summit 2024?
o: Its record drone show was held at Orvakal Drone City
It included a hackathon with AP Drone Corporation
n810781e20e5.x: The record drone show was held at Punnami Ghat, Vijayawada, not at Orvakal; the summit itself was at Mangalagiri on 22-23 October 2024.

new.s: The BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Andhra Pradesh is coming up at:
new.x: BPCL's refinery-cum-petrochemical complex (about 9 MTPA, with an ethylene cracker) is at Ramayapatnam in Nellore.

new.s: In which year was APGIC, the APIIC-APGENCO gas venture, set up?
new.x: APGIC was set up on 2 September 2009 with APIIC holding 51% and APGENCO 49%.

new.s: Bhogapuram greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district is being developed by:
new.x: Bhogapuram is a greenfield international airport developed by GMR; it became operational on 1 August 2026.

new.s: Which of the following airports in Andhra Pradesh is a domestic airport?
new.x: Rajahmundry is a domestic airport; Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati are international airports.

new.s: Which airport was NOT among those the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 said would be upgraded?
new.x: APRA 2014 provided for upgrading Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati airports; Kadapa was not among them.

new.s: The only major port of Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: Visakhapatnam is AP's only major (Union) port; the others are non-major ports.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (port – district) is correctly matched?
new.x: Krishnapatnam is in Nellore; Mulapeta is in Srikakulam, Machilipatnam in Krishna and Gangavaram in Visakhapatnam.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about ports in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Gangavaram is a non-major private port operated by Adani.
2. Machilipatnam is a greenfield port on the landlord model.
3. Krishnapatnam is a major port.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Gangavaram (Adani) is non-major and private, and Machilipatnam is a greenfield landlord-model port; Krishnapatnam is a non-major private port, not a major port.

new.s: The AP Maritime Policy 2024-29 targets a port capacity of how much by 2047?
new.x: The policy targets 300 MTPA by 2047; the +145 MTPA figure is the addition targeted by 2030.

new.s: The AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024 targets Net Zero by:
new.x: The policy targets Net Zero by 2047, not 2030, along with 160 GW+ clean energy.

new.s: The nodal body for Andhra Pradesh's Green Hydrogen Valley Declaration is:
new.x: SRM University is the nodal body of the Green Hydrogen Valley Declaration of 19 July 2025.

new.s: The AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024 targets clean energy capacity of:
new.x: The policy targets 160 GW+ clean energy, Rs 10 lakh crore investment and 7.5 lakh jobs.

new.s: Aravetipalli, the largest APGENCO-approved pumped storage project, has a capacity of:
new.x: Aravetipalli is 1,320 MW; 1,350 MW is Upper Sileru, a project of the APGENCO-NHPC JV.

new.s: APIDC, the body for industrial financing and promotion in Andhra Pradesh, was set up in:
new.x: APIDC was set up in 1960; APIIC came later, on 26 September 1973.

new.s: The land bank of APIIC is about:
new.x: APIIC holds a land bank of 41,998 acres across 635 industrial clusters.

new.s: UDAY (Ujwal Discom Assurance Yojana) was approved in:
new.x: UDAY was approved in November 2015; it was replaced by RDSS in 2021.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a division of South Coast Railway?
new.x: South Coast Railway's divisions are Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam; Rajahmundry is not one.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC), part of the East Coast Economic Corridor, is funded by:
new.x: VCIC is part of the East Coast Economic Corridor and is funded by the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

new.s: The AP Retail Trade Policy 2015-20 targeted how many jobs by 2020?
new.x: The policy targeted Rs 5,000 crore investment and 20,000 jobs by 2020.

new.s: The investment target of the AP Retail Trade Policy 2015-20 was:
new.x: The Retail Trade Policy 2015-20 aimed at Rs 5,000 crore investment and 20,000 jobs by 2020.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Retail Trade Policy 2015-20:
1. It aimed to make Andhra Pradesh a preferred retail destination.
2. It sought to promote e-commerce.
3. It aimed to train 5 lakh youth in five years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The policy aimed to make AP a preferred retail destination and to promote e-commerce; its training target was 1 lakh youth in five years, not 5 lakh.

new.s: Tourist arrivals in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 stood at about:
new.x: Tourist arrivals in AP were 36.42 crore in 2025-26.

new.s: The multimodal logistics parks identified in Andhra Pradesh are at:
new.x: Visakhapatnam and Ananthapur are the identified multimodal logistics park sites in AP.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh in the LEADS ranking:
1. It was an Achiever in 2022.
2. It remained an Achiever in 2024.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP was an Achiever in LEADS 2022 but slipped to Fast Mover in 2024.

new.s: In LEADS 2024, Andhra Pradesh was placed in which category?
new.x: AP slipped from Achiever (2022) to Fast Mover in LEADS 2024.

new.s: How many projects have been sanctioned nationally under the PRASHAD scheme?
new.x: PRASHAD has 54 projects; 52 is the Swadesh Darshan 2.0 count.

new.s: The Simhachalam temple project in Andhra Pradesh is taken up under:
new.x: Simhachalam temple (Rs 54.04 crore) is a PRASHAD project, as is Annavaram.

new.s: Of Andhra Pradesh's 25+ thematic tourism circuits, the temple circuits number:
new.x: AP has 10 temple circuits among its 25+ circuits, along with 2 Buddhist and 5 beach circuits.

new.s: The AP Tourism Policy 2024-29 targets tourism's share in the State GVA at above:
new.x: The policy targets tourism above 20% of State GVA and 20% of the workforce.

new.s: Which institution in Andhra Pradesh leads eSanjeevani?
new.x: AIIMS Mangalagiri leads eSanjeevani; AMTZ is a medical-device hub and IITTM Nellore trains hospitality staff.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh won 'Best Tourism Promotion State' at:
new.x: AP won Best Tourism Promotion State at GTM 2026; the Swarna Andhra Tourism Vision 2047 was launched at the FAITH conclave.

new.s: The Amaravati Drone Summit 2024 was held on:
new.x: The summit was held at Mangalagiri on 22-23 October 2024.

new.s: Drone City at Orvakal, Kurnool is planned over about:
new.x: Drone City is planned over 600 acres, with 120 acres in Phase-I.

new.s: The Information Technology Act, 2000 was last amended in:
new.x: The IT Act, 2000 was last amended in 2008.

new.s: The AP IT (Electronic Service Delivery) Rules were framed in:
new.x: The AP IT (Electronic Service Delivery) Rules came in 2011 and made electronic delivery of services mandatory.

new.s: The AP Innovation and Startup Policy 4.0 (2024-29) was issued by the:
new.x: The policy was issued by the ITE&C Department and is implemented by the AP Innovation Society.

new.s: The AP Innovation and Startup Policy 4.0 targets how many startups in five years?
new.x: The policy targets 20,000 startups and 1 lakh jobs in five years.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh's ITE&C policies, LIFT stands for:
new.x: LIFT Policy 4.0 is the Land Incentive for Tech Hubs policy, giving land to GCCs and IT infrastructure developers.

new.s: Co-working and neighbourhood workspaces under the AP IT & GCC Policy 4.0 are planned in:
new.x: Co-working and neighbourhood workspaces are planned in Tirupati, Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.

new.s: e-Pragati is organised into:
new.x: e-Pragati has 14 packages covering 72 projects in 33 departments.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about AP Fiber Grid Phase-I:
1. It is built on a GPON network.
2. It covers about 24,000 km of optical fibre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Fiber Grid Phase-I is a 24,000 km IP-MPLS ring, not GPON.

new.s: Which body implements Andhra Pradesh's Innovation and Startup Policy 4.0?
new.x: The AP Innovation Society (APIS), under ITE&C, is the nodal body for innovation and startups.

new.s: The AP ESDM Policy with Zone A/B incentives covered the period:
new.x: The ESDM Policy covered 2021-24 and offered 100% reimbursement of stamp duty, transfer duty and registration fee in Zones A/B.

new.s: The APCRDA data centre ecosystem at Amaravati is planned for a capacity of:
new.x: APCRDA plans a 9 GW data centre ecosystem at Amaravati; 7.5 GW is Gujarat's policy figure.

new.s: Mana Mitra (WhatsApp Governance) offered how many services as per SES 2025-26?
new.x: Mana Mitra offered 865 services (SES 2025-26), against a target of 1,000.

new.s: APTS, the nodal agency for IT procurement and cyber security, is:
new.x: APTS (1986) is self-financing and handles IT procurement, cyber security, digital certificates and Aadhaar.
